description: This file implements a service class for interacting with NVIDIA's NIM API, extending an OpenAI LLM service to handle NVIDIA-specific token reporting and API interactions.

classes.name: NvidiaLLMService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with NVIDIA's NIM API, extending OpenAILLMService to handle NVIDIA-specific token usage reporting and API communication.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the NvidiaLLMService with API key, base URL, model, and additional parameters.

methods.name: _process_context
methods.description: Overrides parent method to process context and accumulate token usage metrics, handling NVIDIA's incremental token reporting style.

methods.name: start_llm_usage_metrics
methods.description: Intercepts and accumulates token usage metrics during processing, reporting final totals at the end.
